title: The beat 4 camera cut off the human's feet from frame 733 and Codex from 780
text:
With the six D99 keys played, the figure layer touched the bottom edge of the picture on 166 frames of beat 4, from 733 to 906 (ink within 2 px of an edge on out/animatic-fig-seq-04a), and Codex was half out of the picture by 780. The layout carried no camera numbers, so cameraFromLayout derived the move from the emitter's travel: from the locked pose on 630 to (803, 215) at zoom 1 on 895, a pan up and right written for the earlier three-key figure.

Done 2026-10-19: v3/layouts/s02-cant-build-frame.json carries `cameraPose` (span 690 to 895; start the locked pose; end x 690, y 360, zoom 1): a pan right of 50 stage px, the layout's own move word, that begins as the body turns toward the light and arrives where the crossing starts; the layout's camera words are unchanged. Measured on the re-render (out/animatic-fig-seq, out/animatic-seq): figure ink within 2 px of an edge on 0 of 300 frames of beat 4 (166 before); the figure's lowest ink is picture row 669 of 719 (50 px clear), its highest row 18; Codex lies at picture x 39 to 247 and y 482 to 691 on all 265 frames from 630 to 894, 39 px from the left edge at its closest (frame 879) and 28 px above the bottom; the frame, stage x 910 to 1190, is inside the picture on every frame with its centre 50 px nearer the middle of the picture at the end (x 1000, from 1050).

The move is that small because the stage allows no more. The figure and Codex use 674 of the stage's 720 px of height (the hair reaches stage y 17 on 814 to 825, Codex's bottom is at y 691), so a push or any pan up or down cuts one of them; Codex's left edge (x 89) and the frame's right edge (x 1190) leave 100 px of width. A push toward the lit frame, which the figure's 'through' key small in its light would need, takes Codex or the figure moved in the blocking, which is staging and was not changed here; a zoom below 1 shows the black outside the stage and was not tried. The eye trace does not change with it (270 of 300 frames of beat 4 over 3 %, 24.9 % at 700 and 21.5 % at 780, was 23.7 %): the brightest region is on Clawd, which is p011.

Row 9.5, 2026-10-19: the restaging this proposal said it needed ('Codex or the figure moved in the blocking') is D101's wide beat 4 (p013): the figure at scale 0.34 (0.58 before) with its feet at stage y 600, Codex at 0.9 (1.8), Clawd at 0.75 (1.5), the frame 400 x 410 (280 x 230) standing on the floor line. The camera is as p010 left it (pan right 50 px, 690 to 895). Measured with `scripts/animation/measure-staging.py out/animatic-05-draft-seq out/animatic-05-draft-fig-seq 630 930` on 1280 x 720 frames: the figure's ink is within 2 px of an edge on 0 of 300 frames (166 before), its lowest ink row is 609 of 719 (111 px clear), Codex stands in picture on every frame from 630 to 894 (stage x 108 to 318 in picture), Clawd enters at the right edge on 720 and stands in picture from 750, the frame and the heap lie inside the picture on every frame they are on; `pass: staging - 0 fault(s) over 300 frames`. The script's control is animatic 04's first render, where it names 19 frames of cut feet in 725-759.
before: figure cut by the bottom edge on 166 of 300 frames of beat 4 (733 to 906); Codex half out at 780
after: figure and Codex inside the picture on all 300 frames of beat 4 (0 frames touching an edge; Codex 39 px from the left edge at closest); the through key small in the picture is done by D101's wide restage (row 9.5)
